solution.title: Single-flight token refresh (one shared in-flight refresh, queue and replay 401s)
solution.summary: Keep a single in-flight refresh promise. Every request that hits 401 awaits that same promise, then replays with the new token. Refresh tokens rotate on use, so two concurrent refreshes invalidate each other and log the user out. Persist the rotated pair atomically before releasing waiters.

task.text: Token refresh race: parallel requests all get 401 and each triggers its own refresh, causing a refresh storm, 429s from the token endpoint and random logouts

lessons.text: Save the rotated token pair atomically before waking the queued requests
Increasing the token endpoint rate limit hid the bug in staging but not in prod
Jittered retries on 401 only delay the refresh storm, they do not prevent it

solution.title: Stop rebalance storms: cooperative-sticky assignor, static membership, bounded batch time
solution.summary: max.poll.interval.ms was shorter than the slowest batch so consumers were kicked out. Switch to CooperativeStickyAssignor, set group.instance.id (static membership), cap max.poll.records.

trace.name: recall.vector_candidates
trace.cypher: CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Task','embedding',$n,vecf32($emb)) YIELD node AS t, score WITH t, 1 - score AS sim WHERE sim >= $min_sim MATCH (s:Solution)-[:SOLVES]->(t) MATCH (s)<-[:PRODUCED]-(:Session)<-[:RAN]-(a:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(at:Team) MATCH (v:Dev {name:$viewer})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(vt:Team) WHERE s.visibility = 'org' OR (s.visibility = 'team' AND at = vt) OR a = v RETURN t.id AS task_id, t.text AS task_text, sim, s.id AS solution_id, s.status AS status ORDER BY sim DESC

trace.name: recall.supersede_walk
trace.cypher: UNWIND $ids AS sid MATCH (s0:Solution {id:sid}) OPTIONAL MATCH p = (newer:Solution)-[:SUPERSEDES*1..4]->(s0) WITH s0, p ORDER BY length(p) DESC WITH s0, collect(p)[0] AS longest RETURN s0.id AS id, CASE WHEN longest IS NULL THEN [s0.id] ELSE reverse([n IN nodes(longest) | n.id]) END AS chain

trace.name: recall.expand
trace.cypher: UNWIND $ids AS sid MATCH (s:Solution {id:sid})<-[:PRODUCED]-(se:Session)<-[:RAN]-(a:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(tm:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (se)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:TAUGHT]->(l:Lesson) WITH s, se, a, tm, p, collect(DISTINCT {text:l.text, kind:l.kind}) AS lessons OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:FAILED_WITH]->(e:Error) WITH s, se, a, tm, p, lessons, collect(DISTINCT e.signature) AS errors OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:HIT]->(h:Error) WITH s, se, a, tm, p, lessons, errors, collect(DISTINCT h.signature) AS hit OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:BUILDS_ON]->(b:Solution) WITH s, se, a, tm, p, lessons, errors, hit, collect(DISTINCT {id:b.id, title:b.title}) AS builds_on OPTIONAL MATCH (:Session)-[r:REUSED]->(s) WITH s, se, a, tm, p, lessons, errors, hit, builds_on, sum(CASE WHEN r.outcome IN ['reused','worked'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reuse_ok OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:SOLVES]->(t:Task) RETURN s.id AS id, s.title AS title, s.summary AS summary, s.code AS code, s.status AS status, s.effort_minutes AS effort_minutes, s.attempts AS attempts, s.tokens_spent AS tokens_spent, s.visibility AS visibility, s.created_at AS created_at, se.id AS session_id, se.started_at AS session_started, a.name AS author, tm.name AS team, p.name AS project, lessons, errors, hit, builds_on, reuse_ok, t.id AS task_id, t.text AS task_text
